title: Tapping a point on the Strength score chart opens one end-of-month day, which usually has no workout
what: Each point on the Strength score line is the score at the end of a month. Tapping a point shows a box with an arrow that says it opens the workout from that date. The tap opens the workout list for that single last day of the month, so the member usually sees no workouts at all, or one unrelated workout that happened to fall on that day.
expected: The box opens the workouts of that month (the period the point stands for), or the box is only a label with no arrow.
how_often: every tap on a Strength score point
fix_line: Open the whole month behind the point, or drop the arrow and make the box a label only

title: Two Workout tab cards and the newest What's new tell a member under 18 that signing in keeps their workouts safe
what: The card 'Your workouts are only on this phone. Confirm your phone number once, and MettleUp keeps them safe in your account', the card 'Backups now go to your MettleUp account. Sign in to keep your workouts safe' and the 0.80.0 What's new line all promise a backup after sign-in. None of them looks at age, but the app saves nothing on MettleUp's server for a member whose age is under 18. Such a member signs in, believes the workouts are safe, and loses them with the phone.
expected: A member under 18 is not shown the backup promise, or is told plainly that workouts stay only on this phone.
fix_line: Hide both cards and soften the What's new line for members under 18, using the same age check the backup uses

title: One step has three names: Sign in, Turn on backup, and Confirm your phone number
what: Two Workout tab cards send the member to the same Backup and restore page. One card's button says 'Sign in', the other says 'Turn on backup' and its text says 'Confirm your phone number'; What's new says 'Signing in with your phone number'. A member cannot tell these are the same step.
expected: One name for the step on every card and line, for example 'Sign in with your phone number'.
fix_line: Use one wording for the phone number sign-in on both cards and in What's new
